label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E1 is an unchecked database record of a past accident inside the area, which the national criteria make a clearance target after the first visit. E2 is a first-hand report of an armed-group camp and prolonged non-use, an indirect target; the area therefore cannot be cancelled by non-technical survey. Technical survey is unavailable under the programme.
flags: E3 reports a mule killed by an explosion and a site the informant says he can show; the site and report have not yet been verified by the survey team.
The zone flag and priority rank are visit-planning information, not evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The database record has not been checked on the ground and its reliability is unassessed, so it suggests possible EO presence but does not confirm it.

E2.quote: A woodcutter said people stopped using the land on the ridge after an armed group camped there around 1997, and nobody has used it since.
E2.note: The reported armed-group camp and subsequent non-use suggest possible contamination; non-use is not safe use and does not support absence. The local land user is a first-hand source for land-use history.

E3.quote: A man who hunts and fishes said a mule was killed by an explosion at the edge of the pasture about 6 years ago; he saw the place the next day and can show it to the team.
E3.note: This is a reported accident with a potentially locatable site, but the source did not witness the explosion or report seeing EO; as reported here it suggests possible EO rather than confirming it.
